[[Trample]] is one of the most popular and effective ways of taking out a single character for a Walker deck, and for good reason. [[Trample]] can be played at almost any time, giving it a wide range of situations where it is extremely useful. Also, [[Trample]] can be used to clear out problem characters, such as Kal Fal'nl C'[[Kal'Falnl C'ndros{{!}}ndros]], before a crucial battle.

Combos:

[[Trample]] + [[Walker Garrison]] -- [[Trample]] is a truly and incredibly effective way to deal with [[Undercover (Dark){{!}}Undercover]] spies. Most spies have low to no ability, in the greater scheme of things. The likelyhood of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] donning [[Plastoid Armor]] and coming to [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] simply to go [[Undercover (Dark){{!}}Undercover]] is grim, so [[Trample]] can rid a site of those pesky spies, allowing the large Force drains from [[Walker Garrison]] to walk through unharmed.
|combos=* [[Trample]] + any piloted AT-AT or AT-ST present at a site<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Trample</ref>
* [[Trample]] + [[Walker Garrison]]
